title: Daskam 37 — The Prelude to Krishna's Incarnation
description: Bhūdevī seeks refuge, the devas receive Hari's promise, and the events leading to Krishna's birth unfold in Mathura.
editorial_note: No sourced English translation was available in the supplied materials or the canonical Sanskrit/IAST source. The supplied English captions are preserved as attributed commentary and are not presented as translations.

stanzas.sanskrit:
सान्द्रानन्दतनो हरे ननु पुरा दैवासुरे सङ्गरे
त्वत्कृत्ता अपि कर्मशेषवशतो ये ते न याता गतिम् ।
तेषां भूतलजन्मनां दितिभुवां भारेण दुरार्दिता
भूमिः प्राप विरिञ्चमाश्रितपदं देवैः पुरैवागतैः ॥ ३७-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sāndrānandatano hare nanu purā daivāsure saṅgare
tvatkṛttā api karmaśeṣavaśato ye te na yātā gatim |
teṣāṃ bhūtalajanmanāṃ ditibhuvāṃ bhāreṇa durārditā
bhūmiḥ prāpa viriñcamāśritapadaṃ devaiḥ puraivāgataiḥ || 37-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Long ago, in the battle between the Devas and Asuras, some of the Asuras, even though killed by Bhagwan, were born again on the earth. Mother earth being very much tormented by their burden searched for refuge in Brahmaa and reached his abode, where the Devas had already gone.

stanzas.sanskrit:
हा हा दुर्जनभूरिभारमथितां पाथोनिधौ पातुका-
-मेतां पालय हन्त मे विवशतां सम्पृच्छ देवानिमान् ।
इत्यादिप्रचुरप्रलापिविवशामालोक्य धाता महीं
देवानां वदनानि वीक्ष्य परितो दध्यौ भवन्तं हरे ॥ ३७-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
hā hā durjanabhūribhāramathitāṃ pāthonidhau pātukā-
-metāṃ pālaya hanta me vivaśatāṃ sampṛccha devānimān |
ityādipracurapralāpivivaśāmālokya dhātā mahīṃ
devānāṃ vadanāni vīkṣya parito dadhyau bhavantaṃ hare || 37-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Goddess Earth was crushed by the immense weight of the evil minded Asuras and about to fall in the ocean of waters. Seeing the Earth in such a helpless state and also looking at the faces of the Devas, who had assembled there, Brahmaa meditated on Bhagwan.

stanzas.sanskrit:
ऊचे चाम्बुजभूरमूनयि सुराः सत्यं धरित्र्या वचो
नन्वस्या भवतां च रक्षणविधौ दक्षो हि लक्ष्मीपतिः ।
सर्वे शर्वपुरःसरावयमितो गत्वा पयोवारिधिं
नत्वा तं स्तुमहे जवादिति युयः साकं तवाकेतनम् ॥ ३७-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ūce cāmbujabhūramūnayi surāḥ satyaṃ dharitryā vaco
nanvasyā bhavatāṃ ca rakṣaṇavidhau dakṣo hi lakṣmīpatiḥ |
sarve śarvapuraḥsarā vayamito gatvā payovāridhiṃ
natvā taṃ stumahe javāditi yuyaḥ sākaṃ tavāketanam || 37-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma suggested that only Lord Hari could help at this point and hence led by Lord Shiva, Mother Earth, devas, Brahma and other gods reached the milky ocean and took refuge at the lotus feet of Bhagwan.

stanzas.sanskrit:
ते मुग्धानिलशालिदुग्धजलधेस्तीरं गताः सङ्गता
यावत्त्वत्पदचिन्तनैकमनसस्तावत् स पाथोजभूः ।
त्वद्वाचं हृदये निशम्य सकलानानन्दयन्नूचिवा-
-नाख्यातः परमात्मना स्वयमहं वाक्यं तदाकर्ण्यताम् ॥ ३७-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
te mugdhānilaśālidugdhajaladhestīraṃ gatāḥ saṅgatā
yāvattvatpadacintanaikamanasastāvat sa pāthojabhūḥ |
tvadvācaṃ hṛdaye niśamya sakalānānandayannūcivā-
-nākhyātaḥ paramātmanā svayamahaṃ vākyaṃ tadākarṇyatām || 37-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: All of them went to the Milky Ocean where a pleasant breeze was blowing. As they stood there with their minds meditating, the lotus born Brahmaa in his own heart heard Bhagwan’s words.

stanzas.sanskrit:
जाने दीनदशामहं दिविषदां भूमेश्च भीमैर्नृपै-
-स्तत्क्षेपाय भवामि यादवकुले सोऽहं समग्रात्मना ।
देवा वृष्णिकुले भवन्तु कलया देवाङ्गनाश्चावनौ
मत्सेवार्थमिति त्वदीयवचनं पाथोजभूरूचिवान् ॥ ३७-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
jāne dīnadaśāmahaṃ diviṣadāṃ bhūmeśca bhīmairnṛpai-
-statkṣepāya bhavāmi yādavakule so'haṃ samagrātmanā |
devā vṛṣṇikule bhavantu kalayā devāṅganāścāvanau
matsevārthamiti tvadīyavacanaṃ pāthojabhūrūcivān || 37-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma said that Bhagwan is aware of the sad plight caused by asuras and hence will be born in Yadava clan with all his powers. The Devas will be born as rishis, wives of Devas will be born in earth to serve him. These words brought happiness and peace to all of them.

stanzas.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा कर्णरसायनं तव वचः सर्वेषु निर्वापित-
-स्वान्तेष्वीश गतेषु तावककृपापीयूषतृप्तात्मसु ।
विख्याते मथुरापुरे किल भवत्सान्निध्यपुण्योत्तरे
धन्यां देवकनन्दनामुदवहद्राजा स शूरात्मजः ॥ ३७-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śrutvā karṇarasāyanaṃ tava vacaḥ sarveṣu nirvāpita-
-svānteṣvīśa gateṣu tāvakakṛpāpīyūṣatṛptātmasu |
vikhyāte mathurāpure kila bhavatsānnidhyapuṇyottare
dhanyāṃ devakanandanāmudavahadrājā sa śūrātmajaḥ || 37-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: In the famous city of Mathura, Vasudeva, son of King Surasena, ruling over Mathura city, married Devaki, the daughter of Devaka.

stanzas.sanskrit:
उद्वाहावसितौ तदीयसहजः कंसोऽथ सम्मानय-
-न्नेतौ सूततया गतः पथि रथे व्योमोत्थया त्वद्गिरा ।
अस्यास्त्वामतिदुष्टमष्टमसुतो हन्तेति हन्तेरितः
सन्त्रासात् स तु हन्तुमन्तिकगतां तन्वीं कृपाणीमधात् ॥ ३७-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
udvāhāvasitau tadīyasahajaḥ kaṃso'tha sammānaya-
-nnetau sūtatayā gataḥ pathi rathe vyomotthayā tvadgirā |
asyāstvāmatiduṣṭamaṣṭamasuto hanteti hantēritaḥ
santrāsāt sa tu hantumantikagatāṃ tanvīṃ kṛpāṇīmadhāt || 37-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Devaki's brother Kamsa took the couple on procession in the chariot, to honour them. At that time, Bhagwan's voice sounded that Kamsa will be killed by Devaki's eighth son. Out of fear, he took his sword and caught Devaki by hair and was about to kill her.

stanzas.sanskrit:
गृह्णानश्चिकुरेषु तां खलमतिः शौरेश्चिरं सान्त्वनै-
-र्नो मुञ्चन् पुनरात्मजार्पणगिरा प्रीतोऽथ यातो गृहान् ।
आद्यं त्वत्सहजं तथार्पितमपि स्नेहेन नाहन्नसौ
दुष्टानामपि देव पुष्टकरुणा दृष्टा हि धीरेकदा ॥ ३७-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
gṛhṇānaścikureṣu tāṃ khalamatiḥ śaurēściraṃ sāntvanai-
-rno muñcan punarātmajārpaṇagirā prīto'tha yāto gṛhān |
ādyaṃ tvatsahajaṃ tathārpitamapi snehena nāhannasau
duṣṭānāmapi deva puṣṭakaruṇā dṛṣṭā hi dhīrekadā || 37-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
Vasudeva pleaded  Kamsa to spare her life but those did not make any positive impact on Kamsa. After Vasudeva promised to hand over all his children, the moment they are born, Kamsa let Devaki free. 
When the first child was born, Vasudeva handed over the child to Kamsa. But he did not kill the child out of love.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तावत् त्वन्मनसैव नारदमुनिः प्रोचे स भोजेश्वरं
यूयं नन्वसुराः सुराश्च यदवो जानासि किं न प्रभो ।
मायावी स हरिर्भवद्वधकृते भावी सुरप्रार्थना-
-दित्याकर्ण्य यदूनदूधुनदसौ शौरेश्च सूनूनहन् ॥ ३७-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tāvat tvanmanasaiva nāradamuniḥ proce sa bhojeśvaraṃ
yūyaṃ nanvasurāḥ surāśca yadavo jānāsi kiṃ na prabho |
māyāvī sa harirbhavadvadhakṛte bhāvī suraprārthanā-
-dityākarṇya yadūnadūdhunadasau śaureśca sūnūnahan || 37-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Sage Narada prompted by Bhagwan, advised him that he is an Asura and Yadavas were Devas, Hari the master of Maaya will be born in any of the birth to kill him. Kamsa then chased the yadavas and killed all the 6 children born to Vasudevan and Devaki.

stanzas.sanskrit:
प्राप्ते सप्तमगर्भतामहिपतौ त्वत्प्रेरणान्मायया
नीते माधव रोहिणीं त्वमपि भोः सच्चित्सुखैकात्मकः ।
देवक्या जठरं विवेशिथ विभो संस्तूयमानः सुरैः
स त्वं कृष्ण विधूय रोगपटलिं भक्तिं परां देहि मे ॥ ३७-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
prāpte saptamagarbhatāmahipatau tvat preraṇānmāyayā
nīte mādhava rohiṇīṃ tvamapi bhoḥ saccitsukhaikātmakaḥ |
devakyā jaṭharaṃ viveśitha vibho saṃstūyamānaḥ suraiḥ
sa tvaṃ kṛṣṇa vidhūya rogapaṭalīṃ bhaktiṃ parāṃ dehi me || 37-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan Adhisesha entered the womb of Devaki, when she concieved for seventh time. Bhagwan prompted Yoga Maaya to transfer the foetus to the womb of Rohini. Lord then entered the womb of Devaki at her eighth pregnancy. Devas and Gods praised Bhagwan in appreciation for his avathaaram as Sri Krishna to commence on earth sooner.
